nodes.name: org.tavall.ai.app.memory
nodes.summary: org.tavall.ai.app.memory is the Tavall AI memory knowledge-plane implementation in TavallStudios/tavall-ai-agent-task-manager on branch working/memory-plane-v2, slated for extension rather than replacement by a competing subsystem as of 2026-08-20. On 2026-08-20, the user directed work to finish, validate, repair, and deploy this component to incorporate structural retrieval via Graphify, temporal knowledge via Graphiti, and semantic candidate recall via Qdrant, alongside unified memoryContext hydration, provider telemetry, Model Context Protocol tools, and organization seed and import tooling. Concurrently, requirements specified that ordinary prompts and MCP turns must not create durable memory, durable records require explicit recordMemory calls, prompt history remains in Postgres, raw prompts are excluded from Qdrant, and provenance and supersession must be tested.
